lines.t: Have tiny scales that reach out to their mate, the beautiful females.
And the Lord's grand design brings forth a cocoon, getting ready to hatch from a leaf very soon.
This just period will take just a while
But when it is finished, the wings will have style
From a cocoon to a butterfly, this creature becomes
And with a heavenly language only they could know
Is revealed in the song with a heavenly flow
Praise Yahushua our King who reigns on high
Give Him glory forever, who taught us to fly
